relationships.subject: JAK2 V617F
relationships.evidence_quote: Among these disorders myeloproliferative neoplasms with JAK2 V617F mutations are the most significant risk factors.

relationships.subject: urokinase
relationships.evidence_quote: We observed substantial thrombus regression and resolution of ischemic symptoms, thereby avoiding surgical intervention.

key_findings: Early low-dose catheter-directed urokinase thrombolysis resolved noncirrhotic PVT with impending mesenteric ischemia in a JAK2 V617F polycythemia vera patient.
